definitions.def: to go beyond the limits of something
to keep or continue to have something
lasting for a long time; permanent
to express or communicate an idea or feeling
to understand and share the feelings of another

grammar_choice.en_template: Literature, in its essence, {{1:is/are}} a testament to the enduring power of human creativity and {{2:expression/expressing}}.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 문학은 본질적으로 인간의 창의성과 표현이 지닌 영원한 힘에 대한 증거이다.

grammar_choice.en_template: It transcends time and space, {{1:connecting/connected}} us with the thoughts and emotions of people from all walks of life, {{2:across/cross}} centuries and cultures.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 그것은 시간과 공간을 초월하여, 여러 세기와 문화를 가로질러 각계각층 사람들의 생각과 감정으로 우리를 연결해 준다.
explain: 주절(It transcends)에 부가되는 분사구문(= and it connects) → 능동 connecting.

grammar_choice.en_template: {{1:Despite/Although}} the rise of new technologies and the ever-changing landscape of media, literature {{2:has retained/has been retained}} its relevance and significance as a timeless art form.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 새로운 기술의 부상과 끊임없이 변화하는 미디어 환경에도 불구하고, 문학은 시대를 초월한 예술 형식으로서 그 적합성과 중요성을 유지해 왔다.
explain: 뒤에 명사구(the rise of ~)가 오므로 전치사 Despite (Although는 절을 이끔).
목적어 its relevance and significance가 있으므로 능동 has retained.

grammar_choice.en_template: One reason for literature's enduring power {{1:is/are}} its ability to capture and {{2:convey/conveying}} the complexities of the human experience.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 문학의 영원한 힘의 한 가지 이유는 인간 경험의 복잡성을 포착하고 전달하는 능력이다.
explain: to capture와 and로 병렬된 동사원형 convey.

grammar_choice.en_template: Through the written word, authors {{1:having/have}} the unique ability to {{2:explore/exploring}} the depths of human emotion, the nuances of relationships, and the challenges and triumphs of the human spirit.
grammar_choice.ko_full: 글로 쓰인 말을 통해, 작가들은 인간 감정의 깊이, 관계의 미묘함, 그리고 인간 정신의 도전과 승리를 탐구하는 독특한 능력을 가진다.
explain: ★어법 포인트: 본문은 having으로 인쇄되어 있으나 주어 authors의 본동사가 없어 어법상 틀림 → have가 옳음. (본문 그대로 having 선택)

grammar_choice.en_template: Literature allows us to see ourselves {{1:reflected/reflecting}} in the pages of a book, to empathize with characters different from ourselves, and to gain a deeper understanding of the human {{2:condition/conditional}}.

jumble.answer: Literature, in its essence, is a testament to the enduring power of human creativity and expression.
It transcends time and space, connecting us with the thoughts and emotions of people from all walks of life, across centuries and cultures.
Despite the rise of new technologies and the ever-changing landscape of media, literature has retained its relevance and significance as a timeless art form.
One reason for literature's enduring power is its ability to capture and convey the complexities of the human experience.
Through the written word, authors having the unique ability to explore the depths of human emotion, the nuances of relationships, and the challenges and triumphs of the human spirit.
Literature allows us to see ourselves reflected in the pages of a book, to empathize with characters different from ourselves, and to gain a deeper understanding of the human condition.
